items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But Billie Holiday she used that 'drag.'

ctx.x: Yes, I know that. That was current in '37 when I came.
But Billie Holiday she used that 'drag.' Man this band is dragging me all over the place.

items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: That was the film you were in with Lee and Billy Holiday

ctx.x: Max Kaminsky, yes. The films, let's see, he says, 'Stormy Weather' '43. 'New Orleans', '46. That was the film you were in with Lee and Billy Holiday
wasn't it? New Orleans? Yes, yes.
